defs: def personas: ["wf-read-only", "wf-read-write", "wf-execute", "wf-all"]; def agent($n): first(.config.agents[] | select(.agent_id == $n)) // {}; def tools($n): . as $d | agent($n).context_id as $c | (first($d.config.contexts[] | select(.context_id == $c) | .tools_id) // null) as $t | first($d.config.tools[] | select(.tools_id == $t)) // {};

jq.name: four wf personas ship as agent targets with target_id equal to name
jq.expr: [.config.agent_targets[] | select(.name | startswith("wf-"))] as $t | ($t | map(.name) | sort) == (personas | sort) and ($t | all(.target_id == .name and .agent_id == .name))

jq.name: each persona has its own inference slot
jq.expr: . as $d | personas | all(. as $n | ($n | gsub("-"; "_")) as $slot | ($d | agent($n).inference_profile_id) == "gents:inference-slot:" + $slot and ([$d.manifest.inference_slots[] | select(.name == $slot and .agents == [$n])] | length) == 1)

jq.name: no persona tools list the gents/workflow plugin
jq.expr: . as $d | personas | all(. as $n | ($d | tools($n)) as $t | $t.tools_id != null and ([$t.integrations.plugins[]? | select(.plugin == "gents/workflow")] | length == 0))

jq.name: every persona system prompt carries the shared aliasing paragraph
jq.expr: . as $d | personas | all(. as $n | ($d.assets["agents/" + ($n | gsub("-"; "_")) + "/system_prompt.md"] // "") | contains("Workflow prompts may name Grok tools."))

jq.name: read-only keeps files and bash ReadOnly with network disabled
read-write, execute and all keep files ReadWrite and bash Unrestricted with the planned network modes
jq.expr: . as $d | [["wf-read-write", "disabled"], ["wf-execute", "enabled"], ["wf-all", "enabled"]] | all(. as [$n, $net] | ($d | tools($n).host) as $h | $h.files.mode == "ReadWrite" and $h.bash.mode == "Unrestricted" and $h.bash.network_mode == $net)

jq.name: the pack has no dependency, declares no external service and references no plugin but its own
jq.expr: .manifest.dependencies == [] and (.manifest | has("external_dependencies") | not) and ([.config.tools[] | select(.remote != null)] | length == 0) and ([.config.tools[].integrations.plugins[]?.plugin] | unique) == ["gents/workflow"]

jq.name: every persona prompt carries the web tool aliasing paragraph
jq.expr: . as $d | personas | all(. as $n | ($d.assets["agents/" + ($n | gsub("-"; "_")) + "/system_prompt.md"] // "") | contains("web_search and web_fetch are the same where you have them, and open_page means web_fetch, with focus or offset to read a part of the page;") and (contains("web_collect_evidence") | not))
